content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD source and v3.0 manual을 읽어 governing scheme, main execution flow, 39 Fortran files by role, tools, manuals and wiki links를 지도화한 note이다(1-63행). It identifies fully nonlinear Boussinesq, MUSCL-TVD/adaptive RK/HLL, wetting-drying and two breaking modes (14-18행); then maps driver, flux, dispersion, physics, boundary, infrastructure, feature and input modules (20-45행) and MATLAB/output tooling plus manuals (47-57행).
entities: FUNWAVE-TVD v3.0 local source and manual basis (lines 5,12)
fully nonlinear Boussinesq, MUSCL-TVD, adaptive Runge-Kutta, HLL, wetting/drying and breaking schemes (lines 14-18)
MATLAB preprocessing, binary/NetCDF readers, Google-map plotting, filters (lines 47-52)
converted v3.0 manual and doc PDFs (lines 54-57)

params_defined.default: direct read of 39 src/*.F files and v3.0 manual conversion

calls: time loop invokes ESTIMATE_DT then vessel/meteo/tide forcing (line 25)
time loop invokes FLUXES then dispersion/tridiagonal, sponge and mixing (line 26)
unresolved: verification claims direct read of 39 source files and the module-map heading repeats 39 (lines 5,30), but the table names only 35 distinct .F files when grouped entries are expanded (lines 34-45). Four files are not identifiable from this map, so the inventory is not exhaustively auditable.

the note labels the local source FUNWAVE-TVD v3.0 (line 12), but does not give a commit/tag/hash tying the 39 files to that version; the same repository family elsewhere contains newer releases, so manual version and source version may have been conflated.

execution flow places one combined `dispersion+tridiagonal solve` after FLUXES (line 26). The linked solver design separates pre-flux dispersive-term calculation from post-flux implicit velocity recovery; this abbreviated ordering can misstate data dependencies.

sources.F is grouped under nesting with nesting.F and described jointly as 'grid nesting + source' (line 43), while the physical source-term aggregation is not separately mapped. Ownership and call position are obscured.
the tool map lists a NetCDF reader (line 50), while the module map describes io.F output only generically (line 42). The writer producing the NetCDF interface is not identified.
